summary: One Bright Ray Community High School urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate's core funding and support for schools and libraries, emphasizing the program's critical role in providing reliable technology and connectivity for students and communities.

claims.argument: The program has provided enormous relief to the organization's budget and has become an essential part of its ability to maintain technology infrastructure and connectivity.
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, we would have had to make significant cuts in other areas of our budget to afford the technology infrastructure and connectivity services required to operate effectively.
